description: This file defines a custom React hook `usePrefersDark` that detects the user's system dark mode preference using the `window.matchMedia` API. It manages state and effects to listen for changes to the preference and returns a boolean indicating if dark mode is preferred.

methods.name: usePrefersDark()
methods.description: A React hook that returns a boolean indicating whether the system prefers dark mode, updating dynamically if the preference changes.
